subject: System Design
title: Database Migrations
description: Learn Database Migrations in one minute.

hook.text: You need to add a column to a table with 500 million rows. One wrong move and the site goes down.

buildup.text: Database migrations are versioned scripts that evolve the schema over time, safely and repeatably.

discovery.text: Good migrations are backward-compatible: add before remove, never rename in one step.

twist.text: Large table migrations can lock the database for minutes. Online migration tools avoid downtime.

climax.text: Schema evolution is inevitable. The discipline of safe migrations keeps systems alive during change.

punchline.text: Change the schema without stopping the system.

quiz.question: What is a backward-compatible migration?
options: A change that doesn't break existing code or queries
Rolling back to a previous version
